svg.title: Copying a historical meal into today's log

g.text: Copying a historical meal into today's log
Uses US005 behaviour to access previous logs.
selects a nonempty historical meal and today's destination meal type
Runs in a short write transaction.
Uses the configured clock to determine today.
Validates sourceDate is in the past and within US005's history window.
If today's log does not exist, reuse US004's first-log creation
behaviour with DailyLogFactory and current nutritional targets.
An existing log is write-locked and retains its target snapshot.
First-log creation conflicts retry in a fresh transaction (up to three attempts).
[Each item in the selected source meal]
Create copied versions of the Value objects and entities
Copy stored values only; no catalog or recipe-definition lookup.
Reuse the existing destination grouping when present.
Otherwise create one using existing meal-addition behaviour.
Each type, including Snacks, has one grouping per daily log.
Recalculate nutrition summary using existing US004 behaviour.
saved DailyLog with new item identities
Transaction commits before the successful HTTP response.
confirms the copy and displays today's updated meals and nutrition
